source.publication: 2025 D-40 Booklet (Individual Income Tax Forms and Instructions)
source.section: D-40 Lines 4-7, 15-20; booklet PDF page 19 Line 4; PDF page 20 Lines 16-17 and Calculation I/Tax Rate Schedule; Schedule S Calculation G-1 lines a-h (PDF page 51); standard deduction PDF pages 4 and 13 (record base.deductions cite); additional standard deduction for age 65, born before January 2, 1961 (PDF pages 4, 13, 51; record additional_standard_age65 cite); each of the filer and spouse counted separately (G-1 lines b and d)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (spouse) 70,000.00 + private pension (you) 25,000.00 = 95,000.00. Federal taxable income = 95,000.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 - 1 x 1,600.00 additional for age 65 or older = 61,900.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). D-40 (married filing jointly): Line 4 federal AGI 95,000.00. Line 5 franchise tax 0.00. Line 6 other additions 0.00 (no other-state municipal interest). Line 7 = 95,000.00 + 0.00 + 0.00 = 95,000.00. Line 10 0.00 (no Social Security or railroad retirement). Lines 8, 9, 11, 12, 13 0.00. Line 14 Schedule I Calculation B Line 16 0.00. Line 15 total subtractions = 0.00. Line 16 DC AGI = 95,000.00 - 0.00 = 95,000.00. Line 17 standard (same as federal). Line 18 from Schedule S Calculation G-1: line a basic 30,000.00; lines b and d age 65 (born before January 2, 1961): you age 67 (born 1958-04-19) counts; spouse age 61 (born 1964-08-08) does not count; line f 1; line g 1,600.00 x 1 = 1,600.00; line h 30,000.00 + 1,600.00 = 31,600.00. Line 19 DC taxable income = 95,000.00 - 31,600.00 = 63,400.00. Line 20 tax, Calculation I rate schedule as numbers: 4% x 10,000.00 = 400.00 + 6% x 30,000.00 = 1,800.00 + 6.5% x 20,000.00 = 1,300.00 + 8.5% x 3,400.00 = 289.00; total 3,789.00. (Taxable income is 100,000 or less, so the form reads the tax table: row 63,400-63,449, PDF page 100, gives 3,790; expected keeps the formula figure.) Lines 21-23 credits 0.00; Line 24 = 3,789.00. Whose age counts: each person separately; only the older spouse qualifies, so one 1,600 amount.
accepted_approximations: Tax on taxable income of 100,000 or less comes from the tax tables (50-dollar rows); the projection uses the rate schedule.
